summary.note: All runs completed. Runs marked degraded=true used deterministic fallback (AI providers over quota). Runs marked degraded=false used live AI pipeline.

runs.prompt: Build a CRM for a real estate agency. Agents manage leads, properties, and deals. Admin sees analytics. WhatsApp notifications when a deal closes.
runs.notes: Clean run. WhatsApp workflow stub correctly generated with trigger entity=Deal, event=status_changed, condition=status==='closed'.

runs.prompt: Task manager for an engineering team. Tasks have due dates, assignees, priorities, and status. Team lead gets a Slack message when a task is overdue.
runs.notes: FIELD_REPAIR applied: tenantId missing on Task entity — injected programmatically. Validation passed after repair.

runs.prompt: Inventory system for a warehouse. Products, stock movements, suppliers. Low stock triggers an email alert.
runs.notes: Clean run. Gmail workflow stub generated with trigger on StockMovement, condition checking low_stock flag.

runs.prompt: HR tool for a 50-person company. Track employees, leave requests, and performance reviews. Notify manager on Slack when leave is approved.
runs.notes: CONSISTENCY_REPAIR applied: page.boundEntity 'LeaveReq' did not match entity name 'LeaveRequest' — resolved via fuzzy match.

runs.prompt: E-commerce backend. Products, orders, customers, payments via Stripe. Order confirmation sent via Gmail.
runs.notes: Clean run. Both integrations correctly detected and workflow stubs generated with valid action IDs.

runs.prompt: Event management platform. Organizers create events, attendees register, QR check-in at the door. Confirmation via WhatsApp.
runs.notes: STRUCTURAL_REPAIR stripped markdown fences from Stage 3 output. FIELD_REPAIR then injected missing authRequired:true on 3 endpoints.

runs.prompt: Project tracker. Projects, milestones, tasks. Sync tasks to Jira. Update a Google Sheet with weekly progress.
runs.notes: Degraded mode: Gemini key invalid, Groq TPM exceeded for appspec stage, OpenRouter not configured. Deterministic fallback generated structurally valid AppSpec. Jira and Google Sheets workflow stubs generated with correct registry action IDs (jira:create_issue, google-sheets:append_row).

Prompt has fewer than 3 words. Pipeline short-circuited at Stage 1 with clarification_required=true. Question surfaced: 'What type of application do you want to build and what is its main purpose?' No crash. Pipeline continued with minimal assumptions.

assumptions: PHI compliance flagged as assumption — not implemented
runs.notes: Ambiguous prompt handled correctly. Assumptions surfaced. appType resolved to content_platform.

runs.prompt: A platform with login, payments, roles, real-time chat, file uploads, native mobile, analytics, and a marketplace.
assumptions: MVP scope applied — real-time chat, native mobile, marketplace cut
login=JWT auth, payments=Stripe, roles=RBAC, file uploads=S3

runs.prompt: A CRM but also a project manager but also an invoicing tool.
assumptions: PM features mapped to Task entity
Hybrid: CRM with task and billing extensions
runs.notes: Conflicting domain correctly detected and resolved. CRM chosen as primary with documented decision. All three domains represented as entities.

runs.prompt: Task manager, but make it smart.
assumptions: 'smart' defined as: auto-priority scoring via rule engine
suggested next-action field on Task entity
runs.notes: Vague modifier 'smart' correctly defined and documented as 3 concrete assumptions. appType resolved to project_management.

analysis.degradedModeNote: S7 ran in degraded mode due to Gemini key expiry and Groq TPM limit. Deterministic fallback produced structurally valid AppSpec with correct integration stubs in 38ms at zero cost.
analysis.keyFinding: Degraded mode prevents any hard failures. When all AI providers are unavailable, the pipeline still delivers a complete, validated AppSpec using template logic. The repair engine successfully handled all validation issues in AI runs without escalating to AI_RETRY.
